name: Zigduck Smart Home
description: Control your entire smart home with this handy Zigduck widget in the top bar. Zigduck is a complete home automation system for NixOS. Using this extension you can see and control Zigbee & Philips Hue (+Sync Box) devices, Android TVs, fetch, build and display EPG/TV-Guide, copy current lights state and create a Nix expression & copy it straight to clipboard. Extension uses clipboard only for copying that. There are no extension settings, all configuration comes from your Nix code. Create custom (non-zigbee) devices for monitoring and controlling and wire your own automations. This extension also provides a chat interface and users may write their own natural language commands (no LLM).
